files.explanation: The v2 9-anchor rewards the composer's single Send and hairline rows; the prior round had no anchors.
v2 judges a sparse list by how its rows scale, not by its empty space; prior density 6 and hierarchy 7 under-read a clear title and primary.
Orange on nine controls is 'competing emphasis' (anchor 5), not broken; prior color 4 sat below that anchor.
Send is the only filled control in the dialog (hierarchy 7); prior hierarchy 6 and color 6 did not credit the single primary.
The theme picker panel meets the 8 anchor for hierarchy, typography and color; the sidebar eyebrow and text expanders still cost a point each on typography and coherence.
Prior coherence 5 penalised KyCalendar for a shell unlike KyPost's; v2 scores cross-product shell under ky_fit.suite_cohesion (5), and empty-state density no longer loses for having no events.
Labels above plain fields with one primary meet the 8 anchor; prior coherence 6 again counted cross-product differences now in ky_fit.
Box-per-field is 'nested boxes' (anchor 5); prior density 3 used the 'broken' anchor for a legible form.
v2 labels vintage and keeps equal-weight ribbon commands at the 5 anchor; prior hierarchy 6 and affordances 7 credited the ribbon more.
No create action is visible on the View ribbon, and the low-resolution event text is scored as captured.
New primary and clean folder rows meet the 7 anchor; the move from 'secondary' to 'drive' changes its comparison set, not its score.
Anchor 3 is reserved for broken screens; this legacy page is legible and offers Create, so color and coherence rise to 4.
Empty-month density is no longer penalised for lacking events; typography credited for clear weekday and numeral steps.
